Chapter 815: Chapter 19 What Can You Do To Me? _5

Chapter 815: Chapter 19 What Can You Do to Me? _5

Thus, within the Boundless Void, the dominion of the Evil Gods can no longer be shaken.

“Eastern Wing and the others have already entangled the Taiyin Sovereign, using this opportunity, I can fully explore this World.”

The Tianzhi True Lord was very cautious, even if the Taiyin Sovereign couldn’t return in a short time, he didn’t consider sending his True Body into the Tianqing World, instead, he split off an Incarnation, while his True Body stayed far away, controlling the Incarnation to explore the Tianqing World.

Buzz.

Very quickly.

An Incarnation of the Tianzhi True Lord swiftly entered the Tianqing World.

...

For a being like the Tianzhi True Lord, a Perfect Demon True Lord, invading a world of this scale like the Tianqing World was effortless, especially since the Tianzhi True Lord was skilled in wisdom, which made it so easy to enter the Tianqing World.

“Hmm?”

“This World has nothing special.”

The Tianzhi True Lord glanced around and compared to the fifty worlds occupied by the Taiyin Sovereign, some of the powerful worlds were tens of times larger than the Tianqing World.

Next.

The Tianzhi True Lord mingled among the beings of the Tianqing World, beginning to probe the details of this World.

“This World also prevalently practices Martial Tao.”

The Tianzhi True Lord quickly learned everything he wanted to know.

That is the true source of Martial Tao.

“Martial Ancestor?”

The Tianzhi True Lord’s expression turned solemn, hearing this term for the first time.

Previously, from those dozens of worlds occupied by the Taiyin Sovereign, he had only investigated the Martial Tao Cultivation System and the Martial Dao Cultivators; as for Martial Ancestor? He hadn’t heard it from any Martial Dao Cultivator.

“Martial Ancestor is the source of Martial Tao, is Martial Tao spread by the Martial Ancestor?”

The Tianzhi True Lord carefully pondered, “Who exactly is this Martial Ancestor, could it be the Taiyin Sovereign?”

“Martial Ancestor resides in the Martial Hall of the Canopy Realm…”

The Tianzhi True Lord gathered more information.

Where the Martial Ancestor was, was not a secret in the Tianqing World, basically, any Martial Dao Cultivator would know.

That is the Martial Hall.

For centuries, every once in a while, the High Priest of the Martial Hall would hold ceremonies to venerate the Martial Ancestor, leading all beings of heaven and earth to bow to the Martial Ancestor.

“Martial Hall?”

The Tianzhi True Lord decided to go and investigate the reality of the Martial Ancestor.

Since he was just an Incarnation now, even if he really encountered any danger, it wouldn’t cause any problems; even if the Taiyin Sovereign rushed back, he couldn’t harm him.

Swoosh.

Shortly after.

The Tianzhi True Lord arrived at the Canopy Continent.

Although this was just an Incarnation of the Tianzhi True Lord, with the Realm of the original body, no Martial Dao Cultivator detected him along the way.

“Is this ancient tree also a Demon?”

The Tianzhi True Lord glanced at the Ancestral Demon Tree; although it has been nurtured in the Tianqing World for hundreds of thousands of years, its essence of being a Demon was unchanged.

“This is the Martial Hall?”

Quickly, the Tianzhi True Lord arrived in front of a grand hall.

The aura emanating from here was substantial, causing the Tianzhi True Lord to halt his steps.

“Martial Ancestor is deep within the Martial Hall?”

The Tianzhi True Lord thought for a moment, not acting rashly.

At this point, the Tianzhi True Lord felt an inexplicable pressure deep in his heart.

“Let’s see, who this Martial Ancestor really is, which True Lord is playing tricks?”

The Tianzhi True Lord focused his thoughts, immediately employing techniques to begin projecting many scenes inside the Martial Hall.

What Tianzhi True Lord was best at was divination and spying; divination and spying are two aspects of abilities, and the latter allowed Tianzhi True Lord to see many secrets of the world.

Rustle.

Deep within the Tianzhi True Lord’s eyes, scenes of the Martial Hall began to emerge.

The scenes started moving towards the depths of the Martial Hall, the Tianzhi True Lord saw the rituals and many Martial Dao Cultivators and believers who were step-by-step worshiping.

The scenes the Tianzhi True Lord was watching finally reached the innermost part of the Martial Hall.

This place was now empty, no one dared to cross into this area unless permitted by the Martial Ancestor.

The grand hall was eerily silent, with a solemn atmosphere converging faintly.

“Hmm?”

The Tianzhi True Lord looked around cautiously, spotting a figure sitting cross-legged at the end of the great hall.

“Is that the Martial Ancestor?”

The Tianzhi True Lord’s mind shook, immediately he began to delve deeper into his scrutiny.

The view swiftly zoomed in closer, the Tianzhi True Lord wanted a closer look at the Martial Ancestor.

Just then.

The Martial Ancestor, who was sitting cross-legged, silently opened his eyes.

“This?”

All of Tianzhi True Lord’s attention was drawn to those eyes.

Boom.

The next moment.

The spying Incarnation of the Tianzhi True Lord exploded instantly.

…

Far away from the Tianqing World.

A mysterious backlash, following the connection between the True Body and the Incarnation, descended.

The original form of the Tianzhi True Lord suddenly began to tremble, starting to drop rapidly.

“That was the Martial Ancestor?”

The Tianzhi True Lord trembled with fear in his heart, not hesitating as his figure surged into the sky, beginning to flee frantically towards even farther distances.
